picks.title: Government backs recommendations of NHS doctors-led AI Commission
picks.excerpt: Ministers back independent Commission's blueprint in full, while the MHRA's AI Airlock opens its next phase,
picks.rationale: Primary government release: the UK backs the NHS doctors-led AI Commission's blueprint in full, and the MHRA AI Airlock regulatory sandbox opens its next phase. This is a regulatory event that reaches clinicians and device makers.

picks.title: AI on par with radiologists for finding prostate cancer on MRI
picks.excerpt: A large-scale study of over 22,000 prostate MRI exams found that artificial intelligence achieved diagnostic performance comparable to radiologists for detecting prostate cancer, suggesting AI could help address radiologist shortages.
picks.rationale: A study of more than 22,000 prostate MRI exams finds AI detection on par with radiologists. It is fresh, large-scale diagnostic evidence that bears directly on radiologist shortages.

picks.title: Human–artificial intelligence collaboration for comanaging epilepsy in real time
picks.excerpt: A small epilepsy monitoring study shows that a moderated, large language model-based chat interface lets patients converse with their electroencephalography monitoring in real time, using a smartphone, and patient feedback cut seizure-detector false alarms by about 80% without clinician input.
picks.rationale: Nature Medicine study in which patients talk to their own EEG monitoring through an LLM chat. Their feedback cut seizure-detector false alarms by about 80%, a new patient-in-the-loop care model.

picks.title: 식약처, 임상시험 자료 2672건 외부 접근 노출...AI로 인증 없이 다운
picks.excerpt: [의학신문·일간보사=이재원 기자] 식품의약품안전처가 운영하는 의약품안전나라에서 임상시험 결과 문서 2672건을 별도 인증 없이 외부에서 내려받을 수 있었던 것으로
picks.rationale: Korea's drug regulator (MFDS) left 2,672 clinical-trial result documents downloadable without authentication, and they could be pulled with AI. It is a regulator-level data-security failure with direct trial and patient-data stakes.

picks.title: Repurposing adult AI radiograph models for neonatal care through continual learning: an international multicentre study
picks.excerpt: Continual learning, a privacy-preserving approach, was shown to be effective in addressing a critical gap in paediatric AI by adapting a deep learning model for adult endotracheal tube assessment to neonatal care.
picks.rationale: International multicentre study that adapts an adult endotracheal-tube X-ray model to newborns with privacy-preserving continual learning. It addresses the pediatric AI gap in NICU care.

alternates.title: Johns Hopkins Medicine taps OpenEvidence to bring AI into medical education, clinical care
alternates.excerpt: Johns Hopkins Medicine is teaming up with OpenEvidence to advance the use of artificial intelligence in medical education and clinical care.
alternates.rationale: An academic medical center partnering with an AI vendor. It is a relevant adoption story but a partnership announcement with no concrete care change yet, so it is the first alternate.

alternates.title: From authoring to editing: a competency framework for trainee use of ambient AI clinical documentation
alternates.excerpt: Ambient AI has spread through clinical settings faster than curricula can adapt, shifting trainee documentation from authoring to editing notes.
alternates.rationale: A perspective-style framework for trainees using ambient AI scribes. It has no og_image and would be a third nature.com card.
